content.en: Researchers have developed various algorithms to accurately segment and measure bubbles in scientific images. These algorithms use techniques such as clustering-driven watershed segmentation, adaptive marker-based watershed transform, ant colony optimization, and image processing. The proposed methods achieve high accuracy in segmenting and measuring bubble size distribution, avoiding over-segmentation and under-segmentation, and enabling fault detection and real-time control. These algorithms provide valuable tools for studying and analyzing bubble behavior in different environments, such as mineral flotation processes and gas-liquid reactors.
content.da: Forskere har udviklet forskellige algoritmer til præcist at segmentere og måle bobler i videnskabelige billeder. Disse algoritmer anvender teknikker som clustering-driven watershed segmentation, adaptive marker-based watershed transform, ant colony optimization og image processing. De foreslåede metoder opnår høj nøjagtighed i segmenteringen og målingen af boblestørrelsesfordeling, undgår over-segmentering og under-segmentering, samt muliggør fejldetektion og realtidskontrol. Disse algoritmer giver værdifulde værktøjer til at studere og analysere bobleadfærd i forskellige miljøer, såsom mineralflotationprocesser og gas-væske reaktorer.
